title: [HIGH S6] Fix truncated SHA-256 in metadata_decrypt
acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 hash uses full 64 hex chars (no [:16] truncation)
If Fernet's own HMAC covers integrity, the separate SHA check is removed and only Fernet is relied upon (preferred)
If the SHA file (.metadata.sha256) is kept, format matches Fernet's expected hash length
Test: tampered ciphertext raises InvalidToken (Fernet) or ValueError (SHA check) before JSON is parsed
Test: legitimate metadata loads without error
completion_summary: Fixed 64-bit SHA truncation in 3 places (reader + 2 writers). Regenerated .sha256 with full 64-char hash. Round-trip verified.
